content.stem: 在设定风险偏好并起草风险偏好声明（RAS）之后，哪些措施最能提升整个组织的风险偏好意识？（选择三项。）

options.A: 对员工进行培训，使其了解风险偏好及其限额在安全开展业务中的作用
options.B: 对所有管理人员进行培训，使其了解适当承担风险的重要性和益处
options.C: 将风险偏好嵌入日常流程和治理之中
options.D: 向业务同事说明风险控制措施
options.E: 将与风险偏好的偏离纳入内部报告程序

content.stem_en: What are the most effective measures to boost risk appetite awareness across an organization after a risk appetite has been set and a risk appetite statement (RAS) has been drafted? (Select Three.)

options_en.A: Provide training to staff so they understand the role risk appetite and its limits play in the safe conduct of business
options_en.B: Train all managers on the importance and benefits of good risk-taking
options_en.C: Embed the risk appetite into everyday processes and governance
options_en.D: Describe risk controls for business colleagues
options_en.E: Integrate misalignment with risk appetite into internal reporting procedures
